items.question: In the UAE, within how many days of a Federal Tax Authority decision must a taxpayer submit a request for reconsideration of a tax dispute?
items.fact: Reconsideration request must be submitted within 40 days of FTA decision

items.question: In the UAE tax dispute resolution process, within how many business days does the Tax Disputes Resolution Committee of the Ministry of Justice issue its verdict after receiving the request?
items.fact: MoJ committee issues verdict within 20 business days of request
